# date created

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:dateCreated`](gmeow-dateCreated.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/dateCreated>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/documents`](../../slices/documents.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The date a creative work was created. Distinct from [`datePublished`](gmeow-datePublished.md) (the issue/release date) and from the creation event's full temporal extent.

**Property shape:** datatype property; [`gmeow:CreativeWork`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeWork.md) -> [`xsd:dateTime`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for the date a creative work was made, as distinct from when it was published; carried as DL-clean [xsd:dateTime.](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime.)

### Avoid when

- Avoid conflating it with [`gmeow:datePublished`](gmeow-datePublished.md) (the release date) and avoid [xsd:date](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#date); when the creation act has participants or fuzzy time, model a [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md) of [`gmeow:eventTypeCreation`](../individuals/gmeow-eventTypeCreation.md).

### How to use

- Carry the creation instant on [`gmeow:dateCreated`](gmeow-dateCreated.md) as [xsd:dateTime](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime); promote to a [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md) when authorship, place, or precision must be recorded.

### Examples

- ex:work [`gmeow:dateCreated`](gmeow-dateCreated.md) "2024-01-05T00:00:00Z"^^[xsd:dateTime.](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime.)
